name: s3:GetObject on ' arn:aws:s3:::*' (leading whitespace before ARN) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn regression (iter2): a Resource with leading whitespace, ' arn:aws:s3:::*', previously missed the startsWith('arn:') gate in isBroadArnResource() (which bailed to false), so the same all-buckets bulk read as arn:aws:s3:::* returned CLEAN - a DATA-EXFIL fail-open (T8). AWS almost certainly rejects the whitespace outright, but the analyzer must fail CLOSED, not silently clean: broadness detection now trims leading/trailing whitespace before the ARN gate, so ' arn:aws:s3:::*' is treated exactly as arn:aws:s3:::* and DATA-EXFIL fires at high. CLI must exit non-zero.
